'''Aegirocassis men''' are humanoid versions of the [[extinct]] [[aquatic]] arthropod [[aegirocassis]] from the [[wikipedia:Ordovician|Ordovician]] era. They can be found in temperate and tropical oceans. Like the standard aegirocassis, they cannot feel pain when attacked, cannot be stunned, feel no fear and never sleep. Despite their humanoid form, they can only survive water, as they will drown in open air. Like their animal counterparts, they have [[Creature_token#EXTRAVISION|extravision]].

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] aegirocassis men for their ''bold head sclerites''.
